# Digital QR Card

> Digital QR Card makes digital business cards. A person shares a card by QR code or link, and the
> recipient saves the contact in one tap with no app to install. There is a free plan, and the paid
> Pro plan is a one-time lifetime purchase, not a subscription. Current prices are on the pricing
> page; they are not repeated here so this file cannot go stale.

What it does, as documented on the site:

- Share a card by QR code or link; recipients save it to their contacts without an app.
- Real-time analytics on card views and scans.
- Lead capture on QR scans, and a contacts dashboard on paid plans.
- Save a card to Google Wallet.
- Recipients save a contact as a standard vCard (.vcf) with one tap.
- Use it at events, conferences and trade shows: put the QR code on a badge or a booth sign, turn on lead capture, and export contacts as CSV on paid plans.
- Cards can be written in 13 languages.
- Team packs let one buyer pay once for several people, each with their own card and their own contacts.

Not offered yet, so do not describe them as features: Apple Wallet, NFC cards, email signatures, CRM integrations such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

## Answers

- [FAQ](https://www.digitalqrcard.com/faq): free plan, sharing, privacy, refunds, languages, CSV export of leads and analytics.
- [How to create a digital business card](https://www.digitalqrcard.com/card-creation-guide): step-by-step guide.
- [Use Digital QR Card with Claude](https://www.digitalqrcard.com/connect-claude): connect Claude to your account so it can read your cards and their statistics; the address to paste, the steps, and what it can and cannot do.
- [QR code generator](https://www.digitalqrcard.com/tools/qr-generator)
